comments.body: Seriously, I am shocked at some comments saying that “blaming your own government”… it is absolutely clear to me that politics and people are two very different concepts. I do not think that a person who was born in china/russia should take the blame from the western world regarding their government, it is not like that people have a choice to choose where they come from. It may be true there were spies spotted, but I see the majority are indeed very hardworking people. I think it is really sad and unfair.
comments.author: kidastray
